provenance.what: SYNTHETIC token-standard ledger updates for the CBTC example offline tests.
provenance.isNot: Not a capture. No value was copied from any ledger, wallet or registry. Parties are placeholders, contract ids are invented, and the template ids name packages that do not exist.
provenance.builtFrom: Public Canton Token Standard interfaces at canton-network/splice@fcdadce: TransferInstructionV1.daml (Transfer, TransferInstructionView, TransferInstruction_Accept/_Reject/_Withdraw, TransferInstructionResult), HoldingV1.daml (HoldingView), MetadataV1.daml; the JSON Ledger API update-by-id envelope.
